---
title: Anchovies in Green Sauce
id: MAR-0001
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 50
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 20 salted anchovies
- 1 hard-boiled egg yolk
- 10 g basil
- 50 g parsley
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 dl extra virgin olive oil
## Method
1. Desalt the anchovies under running water, remove the bones, and dry them.
2. Remove the stems from the parsley; wash the leaves, dry them together with the basil leaves, and chop them with the peeled garlic.
3. Put the chopped mixture in a bowl, add the crumbled egg yolk, the oil, and emulsify with a fork.
4. Arrange the anchovy fillets in a terrine in layers, covering each layer with the green sauce obtained.
